sections.html:
Your automations at a glance

Existing Patient AlertWhen an existing patient’s card is moved to a specific stage on your lead board, the assigned team member gets an email right away so nobody misses the follow-up.Starts when: Pipeline Stage Changed
Lead Replies AlertWhen a patient replies to one of the New Patient Follow-Up messages, your team is alerted right away and the patient is marked on your lead board.Starts when: Customer Replied
Reactivation Replies AlertWhen a past patient replies to your reactivation messages, your team gets an email right away so you can call or text them back while they’re interested.Starts when: Customer Replied
New Patient Follow-UpWhen someone requests an appointment, this follows up with them by text, email, phone and voicemail over four days until your team confirms the visit.Starts when: Pipeline Stage Changed
Reactivation Follow-UpWins back patients you haven’t seen in a while. Over about three weeks they get friendly emails, texts, a voicemail and a special offer, and finally a short request for feedback.Starts when: The workflow is triggered in GHL
Website Enquiry ResponseWhen someone enquires on your website, they get a text right away, your office phone rings with their details so you can connect instantly, and your team gets an email with the lead’s information.Starts when: The workflow is triggered in GHL
